# `app.graycard.process.printSession`

One print made in the darkroom or on a printer. Covers silver-gelatin and RA-4 enlarging/contact printing, hand-coated alternative processes, and inkjet / digital-lab output. Workflow-specific detail lives in the enlargement/wetProcess/altProcess/digital sub-objects; fill only what applies.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/process/printSession.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 6

<a id="filtration"></a>

## `filtration`

Dichroic / colour-head filtration for RA-4 or variable-contrast printing. CMY values are head units as printed on the enlarger; magentaGrade is the multigrade contrast grade when using a B&amp;W VC head.

**Kind:** `object`
